I replied in #central-random, in Pree's thread. I couldn't find a ticket number for the West yard Door 2 double-booking at Marrow Fieldworks.

I checked the company brain and the channels Pree can see (#central-team, #help-it-ops). Neither has a ticket for it. The closest match is the Nov 18 QBR notes, which mention Door 2 being used for a late parts unload, but no ticket number is given there.

The reply points her to the support queue or to Tobias Rendle, who has owned the Marrow Fieldworks account since January.
